description: Four stacked-bar charts (Q1–Q4) show, for 37 LLM/interface configurations, the percentage of answers that were Correct, 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error or Incorrect, split by question difficulty (average human score, N = 75).
uncertain: In all four charts the 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error and Incorrect segments of every bar (37 bars per chart) are not tabulated; they are mostly small slivers or the remainder up to 100%.
Some Correct values are estimated from bar height where the printed labels were overlapping or illegible, so they carry a few points of uncertainty.
